evals.prompt: Create drawio wireframes from these app screenshots
evals.expected_output: Produces .drawio wireframe diagrams from UI screenshots with component hierarchy
assertions: documents component hierarchy and visual specs
output is suitable for design handoff

evals.prompt: I need to document the UI structure of this existing app for our redesign
evals.expected_output: Activates reverse wireframing for UI documentation

evals.prompt: Design a wireframe for a new dashboard with charts and a sidebar
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT activate (forward design, not reverse engineering)
assertions: skill does not trigger for new wireframe design
recognized as forward design, not reverse engineering from screenshots
